news.title: What FIFA president Gianni Infantino said to Cristiano Ronaldo as they meet in Paris
news.lede: Under-fire FIFA president Gianni Infantino bumped into Cristiano Ronaldo at the Esports World Cup in Paris over the weekend. Infantino is currently clinging onto his job following his failed Football Forward Enterprise (FFE) scheme - which would have seen stakes in the FIFA World Cup sold to private investors. UEFA, the Asian Football Confederation (AFFC) and CONCACAF have been pushing for Infantino to resign, after writing an open letter calling for “leadership that serves football, not seeks to command it”. Meanwhile, fans’ groups worldwide have launched a petition calling for the embattled FIFA president to leave his post, demeaning wholesale reform of world football’s governing body.

news.title: “You’re lucky to have hair”: Football world drops hilarious reactions as Erling Haaland chops off his ico
news.lede: Erling Haaland has shocked the football world by saying goodbye to his iconic long blond hair. The Manchester City and Norway striker revealed a military-style buzz cut on social media, documenting the dramatic transformation and the hilarious reactions from his friends, family and football stars.Haaland’s new look quickly became a viral sensation. Jude Bellingham, Jack Grealish, Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Pep Guardiola were among those who reacted. His girlfriend Isabel Haugseng Johansen also gave her verdict, while Haaland’s father Alf-Inge joked that his son finally looked like him again.Erling Haaland’s new haircut leaves football stars stunnedErling Haaland revealed his new haircut in a video shared on his YouTube channel and later posted pictures on Instagram.

news.title: India likely to face Panama ahead of Brazil, could play four FIFA World Cup opponents this year
news.lede: The Blue Tigers are likely to play Brazil, Panama and New Zealand this year. India are set for a rare run of international fixtures against teams that featured at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has signed a letter of intent with Panama for an international friendly during the September-October FIFA window, according to a report by TOI. The match is scheduled to take place on the weekend of September 26-27, although the venue has not been finalized yet.

news.title: Diego Maradona’s infamous ‘Hand of God’ FIFA World Cup 1986 ball sells for millions at auction
news.lede: The football used when Diego Maradona scored his famous ‘Hand of God’ goal against England at the 1986 World Cup has sold for £2.5m at auction. The Adidas Azteca ball was sold for $3.3m at Heritage Auctions in the United States on Saturday.Maradona used his hand to punch the ball past England goalkeeper Peter Shilton in Argentina’s 2-1 quarter-final win. He later described the goal as being scored “a little with the head of Maradona and a little with the hand of God”. The ball was kept by match referee Ali Bin Nasser for more than three decades.Diego Maradona’s ball was part of one of football’s most famous matchesThe auction price was below expectations.

news.title: FIFA unveils 2027 Women's World Cup schedule as Brazil prepares for iconic Maracana final
news.lede: Football's global governing body has confirmed the full 64-match schedule for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil. The legendary Maracana in Rio de Janeiro will take centre stage, hosting both the opening fixture and the grand finale. All eight host cities across the vibrant South American nation are set to welcome knockout-stage football as anticipation builds for the historic tournament. FIFA unveiled the complete 64-game fixture list on August 20 at their Zurich headquarters.

news.title: Rodri capture can catapult Barcelona back to very top of European game: GOAL grades the biggest deals of the 2026 summer transfer window
news.lede: For some football fans, the summer is the part of the calendar that they look forward to the most - and that's not just because it's filled by a World Cup every four years! Rather, it's because the end of the season means only one thing: It's time for transfers! The 2026 window is once again proving to be busy, with some huge names making big-money moves before deadline day on September 1. We know that some transfers turn out well for all parties involved, but there are plenty where at least one of the clubs, or even the player, are left wondering what might have been had they made a different decision while at the negotiating table.

news.title: Football: Japan forward Ogawa set to join Machida from Eredivisie's NEC
news.lede: TOKYO - Japan forward Koki Ogawa is set to transfer to J.League leaders Machida Zelvia from NEC Nijmegen in the Dutch top division, a source with knowledge of the matter said Monday. The 29-year-old made his World Cup debut for Japan at this summer's tournament in North America, where the Samurai Blue were knocked out in the round of 32 by Brazil. The parties have reportedly agreed to a deal, with Ogawa expected to join Machida this week on a multi-year contract estimated at around 400 million yen ($2.5 million) per year, making him one of the highest paid Japanese players in the domestic league. The Kanagawa Prefecture native is rated highly for his hold-up play and finishing, utilizing his 186-centimeter frame.

news.title: Diego Maradona's iconic 1986 'Hand of God' World Cup ball sells for $3.35m at auction
news.lede: Bidding opened at $2.5 million on the night of the event before reaching its final hammer price. The publication also noted that the final sum fell short of the all-time record for a sports ball, which remains held by baseball star Shohei Ohtani's 50th home run ball after it commanded $4.392 million in 2024. Timing dampens bidding interestThe artefact previously changed hands for $2.37 million at Graham Budd Auctions in 2022 before failing to sell the following year when a top bid of $2.04 million did not meet the reserve price. Its relisting this summer sought to capitalise on the excitement surrounding the 2026 World Cup.
